The OpenAI‑compatible endpoint that lets apps stream speech audio generated by Ollama on macOS is:

> “`ollama run` plays text or a chat model’s reply aloud as the audio is generated, and apps can stream audio through the OpenAI‑compatible `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint.”  
>  [ollama/v0.40.11.md]
